description: DST hazards for hourly and daily buckets in a zone: skipped hours, repeated hours, 23- and 25-hour days — For a time zone and a date range of up to 1100 days, lists every offset transition and what it does to local bucketing: the hourly labels that never occur (spring-forward), the hourly labels that occur twice and would merge two real hours when grouped by local time (fall-back), and the 23-, 24.5- or 25-hour days; optionally checks up to 500 caller hourly labels (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:00) for non-existent

labels.description: Local hour labels to check, e.g. 2026-03-08T02:00.
